title: Every A1 and A2 model: the record, each exposure's window and its held-out days
caption: The record is split between the exposures at the midpoint between their introductions, so each exposure's models see only their own share: vegan pulled chicken Sep 1, 2023 to May 16, 2026, 989 days (971 before t0, 18 from t0 on, 1 held out at the end); dragon wrap abbots May 17, 2026 to Aug 31, 2026, 107 days (19 before t0, 88 from t0 on, 6 held out at the end). Every outcome of an exposure is fitted on the same window, so each row of the model table below belongs to one window; the A2 customer models split the same way over transactions.
